name: Shitsui no Kioku
source:
After entering high school, Morioka Yuha suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts.
One day, a paranormal photograph brought in as a story for the school newspaper club leads to a series of bizarre events. Will he be able to escape safely...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/14765]Novelgame[/url]]
